verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no-code building surfaces: dashboard assistant creation from templates (vapi-docs-16, vapi-docs-30), dashboard-edited prompts with dynamic variables (vapi-docs-41), and Composer, where you describe what you want and it handles setup (vapi-docs-57). Multi-agent 'squads' (vapi-docs-13) and call transfer (vapi-docs-38) are mentioned, but no visual flow canvas with branching or states is documented. Missing for 10: a documented visual flow/workflow builder, branching and state nodes, a no-code handoff configuration between agents or squads, and independent hands-on corroboration.
